Keep the project and its score workbook private. function props_(){ return PropertiesService.getScriptProperties(); } function setupQuiz(){ const owner=Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail().toLowerCase(); if(Session.getActiveUser().getEmail().toLowerCase()!==owner || !owner || !PLC.team.length)throw Error('A coordinator and at least one teacher are required.'); const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();lock.waitLock(30000); try{ const p=props_(), config=Utilities.base64Encode(Utilities.computeDigest(Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256,JSON.stringify(PLC))); if(p.getProperty('config') && p.getProperty('config')!==config)throw Error('Use a new script project for a different assessment or team.'); if(!p.getProperty('book')){ const book=SpreadsheetApp.create('PLC scores · '+PLC.title); p.setProperties({book:book.getId(),owner:owner,config:config}); } const book=SpreadsheetApp.openById(p.getProperty('book')); if(!book.getSheetByName('criteria'))book.insertSheet('criteria').appendRow(['Response','Decision']); PLC.team.forEach((teacher,n)=>{ const key='teacher'+n; let id=p.getProperty(key); const existing=PLC.sources?.[teacher]; if(existing&&!id){id=existing;p.setProperty(key,id)} if(!id){ const created=FormApp.create(PLC.title+' · '+teacher,false); id=created.getId();p.setProperty(key,id); } const form=FormApp.openById(id); if(existing&&!p.getProperty(key+'Map')){ if(!form.isQuiz())throw Error('Enable quiz mode for '+teacher); const items=form.getItems(); const unique=title=>{ const matches=items.filter(i=>i.getTitle()===title); if(matches.length!==1)throw Error('Expected exactly one question named '+title+' in '+teacher+' quiz.'); return matches[0]; }; const student=unique('Student ID'),period=unique('Class period'), scores=PLC.items.map(q=>unique(q.prompt)); if(!student.asTextItem().isRequired()||!period.asTextItem().isRequired())throw Error('Use required short answers for Student ID and Class period.'); if(new Set([student,period,...scores].map(i=>i.getId())).size!==scores.length+2)throw Error('Each assessment question needs its own matching form item.'); scores.forEach((i,index)=>{if(points_(i)!==PLC.items[index].points)throw Error('Point mismatch: '+i.getTitle())}); p.setProperty(key+'Map',JSON.stringify({student:student.getId(),period:period.getId(),scores:scores.map(i=>i.getId())})); } if(!p.getProperty(key+'Map')){ form.setIsQuiz(true).setDescription(PLC.instructions); // Setup can be retried. Only rebuild an unfinished, unpublished quiz. if(form.getResponses().length)throw Error('Incomplete setup on a form with responses. Review before continuing.'); form.getItems().reverse().forEach(i=>form.deleteItem(i)); const student=form.addTextItem().setTitle('Student ID').setRequired(true); const period=form.addTextItem().setTitle('Class period').setRequired(true); const scores=PLC.items.map(q=>{ if(q.image)form.addImageItem().setTitle('Measurement diagram').setImage(Utilities.newBlob(Utilities.base64Decode(q.image),'image/png','ruler.png')); if(q.choices){const item=form.addMultipleChoiceItem().setTitle(q.prompt).setPoints(q.points).setRequired(true);item.setChoices(q.choices.map((value,i)=>item.createChoice(value,i===q.correctChoice)));return item.getId()} return form.addParagraphTextItem().setTitle(q.prompt).setPoints(q.points).setRequired(true).getId(); }); p.setProperty(key+'Map',JSON.stringify({student:student.getId(),period:period.getId(),scores})); } if(!existing&&teacher!==owner)form.addEditor(teacher); if(!book.getSheetByName(key))book.insertSheet(key); console.log(teacher+' · Edit / publish quiz: '+form.getEditUrl()); }); if(!ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().some(t=>t.getHandlerFunction()==='syncScores'))ScriptApp.newTrigger('syncScores').timeBased().everyMinutes(10).create(); }finally{lock.releaseLock()} syncScores(); } function points_(item){ const methods={TEXT:'asTextItem',PARAGRAPH_TEXT:'asParagraphTextItem',MULTIPLE_CHOICE:'asMultipleChoiceItem',LIST:'asListItem',CHECKBOX:'asCheckboxItem',SCALE:'asScaleItem'}; const cast=methods[String(item.getType())]; if(!cast)throw Error('Unsupported scored question type: '+item.getType()); return item[cast]().getPoints(); } function syncScores(){ if(Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail().toLowerCase()!==props_().getProperty('owner'))throw Error('Coordinator required.'); const lock=LockService.getScriptLock(); if(!lock.tryLock(1000))return; try{ const p=props_(),book=SpreadsheetApp.openById(p.getProperty('book')),errors=[]; PLC.team.forEach((teacher,n)=>{ const key='teacher'+n; try{ const form=FormApp.openById(p.getProperty(key)),map=JSON.parse(p.getProperty(key+'Map')); const byId=new Map(form.getItems().map(i=>[i.getId(),i])); PLC.items.forEach((q,i)=>{ const item=byId.get(map.scores[i]); if(!item||item.getTitle()!==q.prompt||points_(item)!==q.points)throw Error('Question or points changed. Restore the agreed quiz to resume sync.'); }); if(!byId.has(map.student)||!byId.has(map.period))throw Error('Student ID or period field missing.'); const rows=form.getResponses().map(response=>{ const answers=new Map(response.getItemResponses().map(a=>[a.getItem().getId(),a.getResponse()])); const grades=new Map(response.getGradableItemResponses().map(a=>[a.getItem().getId(),a.getScore()])); return JSON.stringify({id:response.getId(),time:response.getTimestamp().getTime(),student:String(answers.get(map.student)||'').trim(),period:String(answers.get(map.period)||'').trim(),scores:map.scores.map(id=>grades.has(id)&&answers.has(id)&&Number.isFinite(grades.get(id))?grades.get(id):null)}); }); const sheet=book.getSheetByName(key),values=['Response snapshot',...rows]; while(values.lengthsheet.getMaxRows())sheet.insertRowsAfter(sheet.getMaxRows(),values.length-sheet.getMaxRows()); sheet.getRange(1,1,values.length,1).setValues(values.map(v=>[v])); p.setProperty(key+'Updated',new Date().toISOString());p.deleteProperty(key+'Error'); }catch(e){p.setProperty(key+'Error',String(e.message));errors.push(teacher)} }); if(errors.length)throw Error('Sync needs attention for: '+errors.join(', ')); }finally{lock.releaseLock()} } function reportData_(){ const email=Session.getActiveUser().getEmail().toLowerCase(),p=props_(); const own=PLC.team.indexOf(email); if(!email||(own<0&&email!==p.getProperty('owner')))throw Error('Sign in with an enrolled school account.'); const book=SpreadsheetApp.openById(p.getProperty('book')); const decisions=new Map(book.getSheetByName('criteria').getDataRange().getValues().slice(1)); const all=[],mine=[],updates=[],unavailable=[]; PLC.team.forEach((teacher,n)=>{ const key='teacher'+n; if(p.getProperty(key+'Error')||!p.getProperty(key+'Updated')){unavailable.push(n);return} updates.push(p.getProperty(key+'Updated')); const sheet=book.getSheetByName(key),latest=new Map(); sheet.getDataRange().getValues().slice(1).forEach(([cell])=>{ if(!cell)return; const row=JSON.parse(cell),id=row.student||row.id; if(!latest.has(id)||row.time>=latest.get(id).time)latest.set(id,row); }); latest.forEach(row=>{ const ready=!!row.student&&!!row.period&&row.scores.every(Number.isFinite); const total=row.scores.reduce((a,b)=>a+(b||0),0); const decision=decisions.get(n+'|'+row.id+'|'+row.time); const status=!ready?'Awaiting evidence':total['Met proficiency','Needs support'].includes(r.status)); const share=!unavailable.length&&assessed.length>=5&&new Set(assessed.map(r=>r.teacher)).size>=3; const skillNames=[...new Set(PLC.items.map(q=>q.skill))]; const skills=share?skillNames.map(skill=>{ let earned=0,possible=0,students=0;const teachers=new Set(); all.forEach(r=>{let scored=false;PLC.items.forEach((q,i)=>{if(q.skill===skill&&Number.isFinite(r.scores[i])){earned+=r.scores[i];possible+=q.points;scored=true}});if(scored){students++;teachers.add(r.teacher)}}); return {skill,rate:students>=5&&teachers.size>=3&&possible?Math.round(100*earned/possible)+'%':'Awaiting team evidence'}; }):[]; return {mine,skills,summary:share?assessed.filter(r=>r.status==='Met proficiency').length+' of '+assessed.length+' assessed met proficiency.':'Team totals are available after five assessed students across three teachers and a successful sync for each class.',updated:updates.sort()[0]||'',issue:unavailable.includes(own)?'Your quiz needs a sync check. Contact your coordinator.':'',edit:own<0?'':FormApp.openById(p.getProperty('teacher'+own)).getEditUrl()}; } function recordCriterion(responseId,decision){ const teacher=PLC.team.indexOf(Session.getActiveUser().getEmail().toLowerCase()); if(teacher<0||!PLC.criteria||!['yes','no'].includes(decision))throw Error('Teacher access required.'); const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();lock.waitLock(20000); try{ const book=SpreadsheetApp.openById(props_().getProperty('book')); const cells=book.getSheetByName('teacher'+teacher).getDataRange().getValues(); const row=cells.slice(1).filter(([v])=>v).map(([v])=>JSON.parse(v)).find(r=>r.id===responseId); if(!row)throw Error('Response unavailable.'); book.getSheetByName('criteria').appendRow([teacher+'|'+row.id+'|'+row.time,decision]); }finally{lock.releaseLock()} return 'Saved. Reopen the results to see the updated decision.'; } function escape_(v){return String(v).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[c]))} function doGet(){ try{ const data=reportData_(); const html='

'+escape_(PLC.title)+'

PLC team results

'+escape_(data.summary)+'

'+data.skills.map(s=>'

'+escape_(s.skill)+' · '+s.rate+'

').join('')+'

My student results

'+escape_(PLC.criteria)+' '+escape_(data.issue)+'

'+data.mine.map(r=>''+(PLC.criteria?'':'')+'').join('')+'
Student IDPeriodResultPoints by question
'+escape_(r.student)+''+escape_(r.period)+''+escape_(r.status)+''+r.scores.map(v=>v===null?'—':v).join(' / ')+'

'+(data.edit?'Open my quiz in Google Forms':'')+'

Oldest successful class sync: '+escape_(data.updated||'pending')+' · Refresh to see the latest sync.'; return HtmlService.createHtmlOutput(html).setTitle('PLC Launchpad · Quiz results'); }catch(e){return HtmlService.createHtmlOutput('Results unavailable. Use your enrolled school account or contact your PLC coordinator.')} }
